projection.note: WebMercator × cos(lat0)，原点为光明区 bbox 中心，x 向东，z 向南，单位米

meta.localAxes: x east, z south, metres; geometry coordinate pair [x,z]
meta.accuracy: OSM community mapping, survey accuracy unknown. 40m is simplification tolerance, not positional accuracy. Administrative maritime boundaries are preserved; landGeometry is coastline-clipped for rendering. Neighbors and sea are clipped at displayBbox.

routes.note: OSM selected alignments; parallel tracks/carriageways retained; clipped outside Guangming; no assertion of operating status.

meta.administrativeNotes: Nine districts are OSM admin_level=6. Dapeng is admin_level=7; its footprint is subtracted from Longgang for non-overlapping display.
meta.sourceDatesNote: Downloaded in 2026-10; OSM database timestamps differ across queries. See per-category osmTimestamp; positional accuracy and latest survey date are unknown.
